title: Universal source whole-cochain scalar reduction counit
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E and F of Q_ell, a Q_ell-algebra map i:E→F, and a scheme W. Use the canonical constant coefficient tensor T and ordinary tensor from [def-pur-constant-scalar-tensor-data], and native ordinary reduction, exact restriction to constant coefficients, the reduction functor D_E, and its whole-system counit from [def-pur-native-reduction-counit-data]. For any recorded derived-system calculus S over E, put O_E=ordinaryReduction_E followed by systemRestriction_E. There exists a natural transformation alpha:Q(D_E T)→(O_E tensor)Q whose component is tensor applied to the canonical constant reduction counit, followed by the exact tensor localization factor. The pair (D_E T,alpha) is a right Kan extension of the ordinary composite followed by Q along the cochain localization Q. Thus for every derived functor H and natural transformation theta:Q H→(O_E tensor)Q there exists a unique H→D_E T inducing theta. This statement makes no comparison with F reduction and has no ramification hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma derived-base-change (Tag 06YY), lemma-derived-pullback-composition, section-derived-limits (0940), lemma-derived-limit-is-ok (0941); derived.tex, lemma-derived-adjoint-functors. Specialization of the original balancing theorem docstring to its source composite.

proof.text: The ordinary completed limit has a right derived functor computed on K-injective complexes. Its unit is an isomorphism on the K-injective subcategory. Postcomposing this unit with any functor preserves these isomorphisms; the K-injective right derivability structure therefore proves that every such postcomposition is a left Kan extension along Qh. This gives the absolute right derived universal property, using the existing native sequence K-injective resolutions.

Use the ordinary reduction/limit adjunction on homotopy categories and the recorded derived-system adjunction, transported through reductionRightComparison. The mate of the right derived limit unit is exactly systemReductionCounit. Its postcomposition with any functor Z is a right Kan extension: transpose any competing counit across the ordinary adjunction, extend it uniquely using the postcomposed right derived limit unit, and transpose back across the derived adjunction. The mate unit and counit identities and the two triangle identities give the factorization and its uniqueness. This elementary categorical argument is proved by the private helper mate_rightKan.

Precomposition with the cochain-to-homotopy quotient is fully faithful on functor categories. Lift a competing cochain counit uniquely through this fully faithful functor and apply the homotopy right Kan property. This proves the same universal property on cochain complexes; the private helper precomp_rightKan proves the factorization and uniqueness.

Take Z to be systemU followed by T. Transport the right Kan extension through the ordinary reduction homotopy factor, the cochain/homotopy localization comparison, and the exact restriction and tensor derived-category factors. Their component formulas give precisely the prescribed tensor of delta. Thus the constructed natural transformation has the required components and right Kan extension property. No K-flat preservation lemma for restriction or tensor is required.

proof_origin.place: Lemma derived-adjoint-functors: adjunction mates and triangle identities. M4 proves the converse universal-property argument directly in Lean from absolute K-injective right derivation; the native counit comparison and exact functor factors specialize it to the source composite.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarSourceCounit_universal (W : Scheme.{u})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W) :
    letI := (tensor_exact l E F i W).1
    letI := (tensor_exact l E F i W).2
    letI := ordinaryReduction_additive l E W
    letI := systemRestriction_additive l E W
    let O := ordinaryReduction l E W ⋙ systemRestriction l E W
    letI : O.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((ordinaryReduction l E W ⋙ systemRestriction l E W).Additive)
    let γ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ) :=
      S.reduction.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app P) ≫
        (systemReductionCounit l E W S).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          (((ordinaryReduction l E W).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app
          (((ordinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    let δ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ) :
        (reduction l E W S).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((O.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) :=
      (systemU l E W).map (γ P) ≫
        (systemRestriction l E W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((ordinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    letI : (O ⋙ tensor l E F i W).Additive := inferInstance
    ∃ α : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (reduction l E W S ⋙ T l E F i W) ⟶
        ((O ⋙ tensor l E F i W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ,
        α.app P = (T l E F i W).map (δ P) ≫
          (tensor l E F i W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((O.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ∧
      (reduction l E W S ⋙ T l E F i W).IsRightKanExtension α
